disposition.reason: A restatement of a known conjecture in a special case; the selected candidate is strictly sharper and carries the consequence this one lacks.

notes: Kept as a neighbour of the selected candidate so that the openness finding covers it.
observation: This is the exact special case of a stated conjecture; it does not imply nonnegativity of the generating-function numerator and it is implied by the selected candidate.

source.reference: Haase-McAllister 2008, Conjecture 3.2, restricted to the family they name as motivation.

statement: For every triple with $c^{\nu}_{\lambda\mu}>0$, the hive polytope $H(\lambda,\mu,\nu)$ is $\mathrm{GL}_D(\mathbb{Z})$-equidecomposable with a disjoint union of integral open simplices.
